prior.name: router preference

lora_stack.name: LoRA stack
lora_stack.tooltip: Optional. A LoRA stack: file, model strength, clip strength. Each entry is added with the model strength. When this is connected, it is used instead of the LoRA file above.

shuffle.name: shuffle

pick_min.name: pick min

pick_max.name: pick max

strength_min.name: strength min

strength_max.name: strength max

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Shuffle: the same seed gives the same pick.

sets.name: mod list

mask_a.name: mask a
mask_a.tooltip: Optional. The region of the entries with region a.

mask_b.name: mask b

mode.name: mode
mode.tooltip: Shuffle: random picks or picks based on local counts.

reset_state.name: reset state
reset_state.tooltip: Clear the local Shuffle counts for this palette.

reward.name: reward
reward.tooltip: Learn mode: rate the seeded pick. Restore the image seed and settings, with no intervening state changes; use fixed seed, then set reward back to none.

embedding_model_path.name: embedding model path
embedding_model_path.tooltip: Path to the local embedding model used by Shuffle in embedding mode.

1.name: trigger words

KiLoRALoadOrder.description: Shows the load order and any problems. The model is not changed.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model the list would load into. It is not changed.

depth.name: depth
depth.tooltip: Number of passes. -1 uses the depth the mod recommends.

KiLoRAApply.description: Loads all mods of a mod list into a copy of the model.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model to load into. The original model is not changed.

sets.name: mod list
sets.tooltip: The mod list from the last mod list node.

depth.name: depth
depth.tooltip: Number of passes. -1 uses the depth the mod recommends.

iteration.name: iteration
iteration.tooltip: How depth passes work. mod: the mode the mod chose. accumulate: each pass adds its change. path: each pass picks the next expert, and the result is that expert's change.

depth_schedule.name: depth schedule
depth_schedule.tooltip: Optional. A KiLoRA Depth Schedule. It replaces the depth input and the default schedule of the mods.

routing_scope.name: routing scope
routing_scope.tooltip: Which logits choose the experts. mod: the scope stored in each mod. token: each token on its own. tensor: the mean over all tokens, one choice for the whole tensor.

routing_select.name: routing select
routing_select.tooltip: How the logits become expert weights. mod: the selection stored in each mod. sparsemax: weights that sum to 1, weak experts at 0. top1: only the best expert.

output_gate.name: output gate
output_gate.tooltip: How each mod's change is limited. mod: the mode the mod chose. auto: adaptive, or both if the mod has a trained gate. adaptive: each output channel and token keeps less of a change that is large against its own base scale or that flips direction. learned: the mod's trained gate only. both: the product. none: no gate.

gate_kappa.name: gate kappa
gate_kappa.tooltip: The scale of the adaptive gate. A change of kappa times the base scale is kept with probability 0.5. Smaller values limit more. 0 uses the mod's value.

path_width.name: path width
path_width.tooltip: Path iteration only. The number of walks: they start from the best experts of the first step, and each walk goes on from its own query. A larger width finds the right expert after a wrong first step. 0 uses the mod's value (1 by default: one walk).

path_select.name: path select
path_select.tooltip: Path iteration only. How each token picks the result of one walk. mod: the mod's choice. converged: a walk that reached a fixed point wins, then the higher path score. score: the path score only. mix: a mix of the walks, weighted by their path scores.

clip.name: clip
clip.tooltip: Optional. The text encoder layers of the mods and LoRA files apply to this CLIP, as ComfyUI's LoRA loader does. Use the clip output for the prompt.

route_freeze.name: route freeze
route_freeze.tooltip: Speed. From this sampling progress on (0.4: after 40% of the steps), each layer stops routing: it keeps the expert weights and gate of that step as fixed scales and runs one low-rank product, about as fast as a plain LoRA. 0 uses the mod's value (off by default).

timeline.name: timeline
timeline.tooltip: Optional. Time-dependent values from KiLoRA Timeline. Without it nothing changes.

settings.name: settings
settings.tooltip: Optional. KiLoRA settings. An input of this node that is not at its default replaces the value of the settings.

depth_map.name: depth_map
depth_map.tooltip: Optional. A depth per image area from KiLoRA Depth Map. From its start progress on, it replaces the depth on image tokens.

linear_jump.name: linear jump
linear_jump.tooltip: Approximate later depth passes with a fitted map. Off by default; image quality can change.

jump_threshold.name: jump residual limit
jump_threshold.tooltip: Maximum relative fitting error for using the approximation at a layer. Higher errors keep the full loop.

axis_alpha.name: axis_alpha
axis_alpha.tooltip: Off is the default. Creative and IP share one budget per token. Auto blends them using previous-step trigger attention, or alpha_mask when connected.

alpha_mask.name: alpha mask
alpha_mask.tooltip: Optional IP alpha mask when axis_alpha is auto. It replaces trigger maps and its edge is feathered over 16 pixels. With axis_alpha off it has no effect.

gate_history.name: gate history
gate_history.tooltip: full updates the adaptive gate at every depth step. head:k fixes its keep rates after the first k steps (k must be at least 1).

expert_text.name: expert_text
expert_text.tooltip: Auto prepares separate text conditioning for experts in layered mode. Off keeps the shared text path.

variation.name: variation
variation.tooltip: Entry sampling temperature for derived routing. Zero selects deterministically.

record_history.name: record history
record_history.tooltip: Record file hashes and date locally. Turn off to stop recording.

candidates.name: Candidates
candidates.tooltip: Choose this many experts before routing. 0 or at least the expert count uses every expert.

attention_route.name: attention route (deprecated)
attention_route.tooltip: Deprecated and ignored. Attention projections use the same routing and depth as other mounts.

attention_route_cap.name: attention route cap (deprecated)
attention_route_cap.tooltip: Deprecated and ignored. Kept to preserve saved workflow widget positions.

size_norm.name: size norm
size_norm.tooltip: off: each LoRA entry uses its own size norm setting. weight: every LoRA entry of the chain gets one size number per file. The number only shrinks: a file larger than a typical library LoRA is brought down to that size. A weaker file always keeps its own size, also with radial budget on. The report names the rule for each file. Mods and packs keep their stored strength.

radial_step.name: radial step
radial_step.tooltip: Accumulate depth loop. The step size of the part of each later depth step that changes the size of the change along its current direction. 1 adds it as is. 0 keeps the size, so only the direction changes. With 1, 1 and a budget of 0, the depth steps add as before. The default is 0.5.

orthogonal_step.name: orthogonal step
orthogonal_step.tooltip: Accumulate depth loop. The step size of the part of each later depth step that changes the direction of the change. 1 adds it as is. 0 keeps the direction, so only the size changes.

radial_budget.name: radial budget
radial_budget.tooltip: Accumulate depth loop. A size limit for the radial step, per token: this many times the size of the change after the first depth step. The orthogonal part is not cut. 0 is off.

0.name: model
0.tooltip: The model with the mods.

1.name: report
1.tooltip: What happened, and any notes.

2.name: clip
2.tooltip: The CLIP with the text encoder layers of the mods. Without text encoder layers it is the CLIP you connected.

KiLoRALiveSave.description: Undo, reset, save points and loading for a live mod.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model from KiLoRA Load Mod or KiLoRA Apply Mod List, with a live mod.

action.name: action
action.tooltip: undo: one step back. reset: back to the start (undo restores it). save point, load: named saves.

name.name: name
name.tooltip: The name of the save point.

mod.name: mod
mod.tooltip: The ID of the live mod, or all.

KiLoRALiveOptions.description: Turns learning on or off, and sets the learning speed.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: Put before the sampler to record a live mod or imported LoRAs, even without a live mod.

mod.name: mod
mod.tooltip: The ID of the live mod. Leave empty if only one is loaded.

learning.name: learning
learning.tooltip: On: the mod learns from your images. Off: it keeps its state.

speed.name: speed
speed.tooltip: Learning speed. -1 uses the mod's default. Higher values change the mod faster.

keep_previous.name: keep last image
keep_previous.tooltip: on: the live state also keeps the last image and its prompt, for editors that compare two images. unchanged: keep the current choice.

measure_size.name: learning size (expert)
measure_size.tooltip: Expert. The longer side, in pixels, of the copy that learning measures: 256 to 4096, rounded to 16. Type the image size to measure at full size (slower). 0: unchanged. The default is 512.

reduce_with.name: reduce with
reduce_with.tooltip: How the smaller copy is made. latent: fast, no VAE needed. decode-resize-encode: needs the VAE input of KiLoRA Live: 2. Write. unchanged: keep the current choice.

pin.name: pin
pin.tooltip: Keep rendering the current state while learning continues. Off follows the latest write; unchanged keeps the current setting.

controller.name: controller
controller.tooltip: r1: baseline write rule (default). rprop: sign controller. unchanged keeps the current choice.

measure.name: measurement budget
measure.tooltip: How the imported editor measures its moves. compressed: a fixed number of random combinations of all moves per write, two passes each, then an estimate of every slope. full: two passes per move, slower. unchanged: keep the current choice. The default is compressed.

measure_combos.name: combinations per write
measure_combos.tooltip: The number of random combinations that the compressed measurement uses per write. A write costs two passes per combination. 0: unchanged. The default is 8.

edits.name: edits
edits.tooltip: Edits change each LoRA core matrix and strength per layer, plus pack terms. Source files are never written. off restores the imported LoRAs exactly. unchanged keeps the current choice.

measure_samples.name: samples per write measurement
measure_samples.tooltip: Samples per write measurement: the same noise and timesteps for every trial. More samples measure more steadily and cost more time. 1 = one sample at the middle timestep.

learn.name: learning signal
learn.tooltip: How a write learns. measure: measure the slopes with extra forward passes (the default). prediction: solve the update in closed form from the prediction errors that the generation recorded, with no measurement pass; the guard runs on the next generation. unchanged keeps the current choice.

KiLoRALivePacks.description: Lists the installed editor packs, turns packs on or off, and shows the packs of the loaded save.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model from KiLoRA Load Mod or KiLoRA Apply Mod List, with a live mod.

mod.name: mod
mod.tooltip: The ID of the live mod. Leave empty if only one is loaded.

packs.name: packs
packs.tooltip: auto: the common pack and the pack for the mod's family. common only: only the common pack. pinned: the pack versions of the loaded save.

turned_off.name: turned off
turned_off.tooltip: Pack IDs to turn off, separated by commas.

editor_kind.name: editor
editor_kind.tooltip: The editor of the packs. Leave empty if packs of only one editor are installed.

measurement.name: measurement
measurement.tooltip: How the editor measures each direction. central: two passes, more exact. one-sided: one pass plus a shared base pass, faster. unchanged: keep the current choice.

time_bins.name: time bins
time_bins.tooltip: The number of noise levels at which the editor measures: 1 or 2. unchanged: keep the current choice.

families.name: families
families.tooltip: Optional. Family packs to use next to the common pack, as a comma list of family names (for example ink_line). Empty: auto takes the mod's family pack, or all installed family packs.

path_merge.name: path merge
path_merge.tooltip: Merge observed expert paths into the editor state. On by default. unchanged keeps the current choice.

path_angle.name: path rotation angle
path_angle.tooltip: Rotation angle in radians for editor path merging. Default: 0.05.

cross_layer.name: cross-layer links
cross_layer.tooltip: Use recorded links in the path merge. Off by default. unchanged keeps the current choice.

keep_merge_pairs.name: keep merge pairs
keep_merge_pairs.tooltip: Keep before and after coefficients for up to 32 merges per branch. Off by default.

merge_residual.name: merge residual
merge_residual.tooltip: Keep the part outside the direction set, or drop it. Default: keep.

term_budget.name: term budget
term_budget.tooltip: Compact a node after its term count exceeds this number. Default: 64.

explore.name: explore
explore.tooltip: Favor less-used directions in inspiration draws. Zero turns this off. Explore draws keep no path-merge residuals, even with merge residual set to keep.

samples.name: latent
samples.tooltip: The latent from the sampler. It passes through unchanged.

vae.name: vae

mask.name: mask

region_caption.name: region caption
region_caption.tooltip: Optional. A caption for the marked region. It names the concept, so later generations can find it. It needs the CLIP on Record.

path.name: record
path.tooltip: The record output of KiLoRA Live: 1. Record.

vae.name: vae
vae.tooltip: VAE for encoding images into the connected model’s latent format.

cue.name: Cue
cue.tooltip: Cue added to each caption, for example a style word.

ignore_guard.name: Ignore guard
ignore_guard.tooltip: Commit the change even if the held-out loss goes up or the drift is over the bound. Adds a warning to the report.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: IMAGE batch. Use either images or folder. You are responsible for the rights to these images.

captions.name: Captions
captions.tooltip: One caption per image, one line per caption. Leave empty to use the cue alone for all images.

folder.name: Folder
folder.tooltip: Folder of images with optional same-name .txt captions. Use either folder or images.

clip.name: clip
clip.tooltip: Text encoder for the captions and the drift prompts. Required.

mounts.name: Mounts
mounts.tooltip: Optional mount name patterns, one per line or separated by commas, for example transformer_blocks.1*. Only matching mounts change. Empty: all mounts.

t_min.name: t min
t_min.tooltip: Lowest sampler time of the samples, from 0 (last step, least noise) to 1 (first step, most noise). Low noise changes detail and texture.

t_max.name: t max
t_max.tooltip: Highest sampler time of the samples, from 0 to 1. High noise changes composition and overall style. With 0 and 1, all steps are used.

mask.name: mask
mask.tooltip: Optional region mask, resized to the latent tokens. Only white areas give the change; the error in black areas is set to 0.

axis.name: axis
axis.tooltip: Optional editor axis. Only the frames of LoRAs on this axis give terms. all: every axis.

single_image.name: Single image
single_image.tooltip: Learn from exactly one image. No set mean is taken and the held-out loss guard is off. The report warns that the result can copy the image content. The drift check stays on.

0.name: record
0.tooltip: The same record, for the next live node.

1.name: report
1.tooltip: Held-out loss without and with the change, relative gain, drift, write norm, branch and time.

mask.name: mask

apply_to.name: apply to
apply_to.tooltip: whole list: every mod in the incoming list. last mod: only the mod added last.

caption.name: caption

segs.name: segs

preset.name: preset

blocks.name: blocks

preview_kind.name: preview layer kind

0.name: depth schedule

1.name: preview

KiLoRARegionAttention.description: Experimental. Keeps the change of each KiLoRA region inside its region. In a window of sampling after the layout forms, the tokens of a region attend less (soft) or not at all (hard) to tokens outside it. Connect it after KiLoRA Apply.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model to load into. The original model is not changed.

mode.name: mode
mode.tooltip: off: no change. soft: a region looks less at the rest of the image. hard: a region does not look at the rest of the image.

strength.name: strength
strength.tooltip: How much less a region looks outside itself in soft mode. Start low: high values change the image.

until.name: until
until.tooltip: Where the window ends, as a part of the sampler steps. 0.6: the limit stops after 60% of the steps.

outside_region.name: outside region
outside_region.tooltip: On: the area outside every region counts as one more region, so it does not look into the regions. Use it for a single region.

start.name: start
start.tooltip: Where the window starts, as a part of the sampler steps. Steps before it never change, so the layout forms freely. 0.3: after the first 30% of the steps.

region_captions.name: region captions
region_captions.tooltip: On: regions with a caption follow their own caption in the same window of steps (regional prompting). The rest of the image follows the prompt.

KiLoRASimple.description: KiLoRA settings with one choice: how the LoRAs mix. Connect it to the settings input of KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA LoRA node. The mix values: balanced: the defaults of KiLoRA Apply, with depth and routing from each mod. keep_each_strong: each token takes only its best LoRA, at full strength (routing scope token, routing select top1). subtle: one pass and one smooth blend per layer (depth 1, routing scope tensor, routing select sparsemax). stack: KiLoRA LoRA Loader does not route and gives the same output as Load LoRA. The other nodes use the balanced values for stack.

mix.name: mix
mix.tooltip: How the LoRAs mix. balanced: the defaults of KiLoRA Apply, with depth and routing from each mod. keep_each_strong: each token takes only its best LoRA, at full strength (routing scope token, routing select top1). subtle: one pass and one smooth blend per layer (depth 1, routing scope tensor, routing select sparsemax). stack: KiLoRA LoRA Loader does not route and gives the same output as Load LoRA. The other nodes use the balanced values for stack. With balanced, LoRA files route at depth 3 and freeze their routing at 0.4 of the steps; stack is one pass.

0.name: settings
0.tooltip: The settings. Connect them to KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA LoRA node.

KiLoRASettings.description: KiLoRA settings: a mix, and single values that replace the values of the mix. Connect it to the settings input of KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA LoRA node. Content keys default to per_expert; mix is the compatibility choice. Fused gate statistics are faster; torch reproduces images made before this release.

mix.name: mix
mix.tooltip: How the LoRAs mix. balanced: the defaults of KiLoRA Apply, with depth and routing from each mod. keep_each_strong: each token takes only its best LoRA, at full strength (routing scope token, routing select top1). subtle: one pass and one smooth blend per layer (depth 1, routing scope tensor, routing select sparsemax). stack: KiLoRA LoRA Loader does not route and gives the same output as Load LoRA. The other nodes use the balanced values for stack. With balanced, LoRA files route at depth 3 and freeze their routing at 0.4 of the steps; stack is one pass.

depth.name: depth
depth.tooltip: Number of passes. -2 takes the depth of the mix. -1 uses the depth that the mods recommend.

iteration.name: iteration
iteration.tooltip: How depth passes work. from mix: the value of the mix. mod: the mode the mod chose. accumulate: each pass adds its change. path: each pass picks the next expert, and the result is that expert's change.

routing_scope.name: routing scope
routing_scope.tooltip: Which logits choose the experts. from mix: the value of the mix. mod: the scope stored in each mod. token: each token on its own. tensor: the mean over all tokens, one choice for the whole tensor.

routing_select.name: routing select
routing_select.tooltip: How the logits become expert weights. from mix: the value of the mix. mod: the selection stored in each mod. sparsemax: weights that sum to 1, weak experts at 0. top1: only the best expert.

depth_schedule.name: depth schedule
depth_schedule.tooltip: Optional. A KiLoRA Depth Schedule. It replaces the depth input and the default schedule of the mods.

lycoris_apply.name: LyCORIS apply
lycoris_apply.tooltip: For routed LoKr and LoHa files, truncated applies the low-rank change; exact applies the whole change.

candidates.name: Candidates
candidates.tooltip: Choose this many experts before routing. 0 or at least the expert count uses every expert.

candidate_summary.name: candidate summary
candidate_summary.tooltip: Choose content keys or leading read-map directions to select candidates.

content_keys.name: content keys
content_keys.tooltip: per_expert (default) caches keys for each LoRA. mix is the compatibility choice. KILORA_CONTENT_KEYS overrides this setting.

gate_stats.name: gate statistics
gate_stats.tooltip: fused (default) is faster. torch reproduces images made before this release. KILORA_GATE_STATS overrides this setting.

routing_features.name: routing features
routing_features.tooltip: Collect optional inputs for routing scores.

cross_token_region.name: token region cross
cross_token_region.tooltip: Weight for the token and region routing score product.

cross_token_prompt.name: token prompt cross
cross_token_prompt.tooltip: Weight for the token and prompt routing score product.

cross_token_timestep.name: token timestep cross
cross_token_timestep.tooltip: Weight for the token and timestep routing score product.

0.name: settings
0.tooltip: The settings. Connect them to KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA LoRA node.

KiLoRALoRALoader.description: Use it in place of Load LoRA. It patches CLIP like Load LoRA. The model LoRAs of all chained KiLoRA LoRA Loaders are routed together when sampling starts. With mix set to stack, the output is the same as Load LoRA.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model to load into. The original model is not changed.

clip.name: clip
clip.tooltip: The text encoder. It gets the LoRA the same way as with Load LoRA.

strength_model.name: strength model
strength_model.tooltip: The LoRA weight on the model, as in Load LoRA. Routing keeps this strength for each LoRA.

strength_clip.name: strength clip
strength_clip.tooltip: The LoRA weight on the text encoder, as in Load LoRA.

lora_stack.name: LoRA stack
lora_stack.tooltip: Optional. More LoRAs as a list of (LoRA file, strength model, strength clip). They load before the LoRA of this node.

timeline.name: timeline
timeline.tooltip: Optional. Time-dependent values from KiLoRA Timeline. Without it nothing changes.

settings.name: settings
settings.tooltip: Optional. KiLoRA settings. Without them, the defaults apply.

depth_map.name: depth_map
depth_map.tooltip: Optional. A depth per image area from KiLoRA Depth Map. From its start progress on, it replaces the depth on image tokens.

axis_alpha.name: axis_alpha
axis_alpha.tooltip: Off is the default. Creative and IP share one budget per token. Auto blends them using previous-step trigger attention, or alpha_mask when connected.

alpha_mask.name: alpha mask
alpha_mask.tooltip: Optional IP alpha mask when axis_alpha is auto. It replaces trigger maps and its edge is feathered over 16 pixels. With axis_alpha off it has no effect.

expert_text.name: expert_text
expert_text.tooltip: Auto prepares separate text conditioning for experts in layered mode. Off keeps the shared text path.

0.name: model
0.tooltip: The model. The LoRAs are routed when sampling starts.

1.name: clip
1.tooltip: The text encoder with the LoRA.

KiLoRARouteLoaded.description: Put it after your LoRA loaders. It takes the LoRAs that the loaders put on the model and routes them with KiLoRA. Each LoRA keeps its model strength. CLIP is not changed. If the LoRAs cannot be told apart, they stay as loaded and the report says so.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model after your LoRA loaders. The original model is not changed.

settings.name: settings
settings.tooltip: Optional. KiLoRA settings. Without them, the defaults apply.

0.name: model
0.tooltip: The model with the loaded LoRAs routed.

1.name: report
1.tooltip: What happened, and any notes.

KiLoRARouteRecord.description: Records where each LoRA acts while the sampler runs. Connect its model to the sampler and its routes to KiLoRA Route Map.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model with KiLoRA routing (after KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA loader).

0.name: model
0.tooltip: The model that records the routing. Connect it to the sampler.

1.name: routes
1.tooltip: The recorded routing shares. Connect them to KiLoRA Route Map.

KiLoRARouteMap.description: Shows where each LoRA acted in the last sampled image: one colored panel per LoRA, with a legend. Connect the routes of KiLoRA Route Record and the decoded image.

routes.name: routes
routes.tooltip: The routes of KiLoRA Route Record.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: The decoded image of the same sampler run.

labels.name: labels
labels.tooltip: The LoRA names, separated by commas, in load order. Missing names become LoRA 1, LoRA 2, and so on.

0.name: map
0.tooltip: One panel per LoRA: the image, colored where the LoRA acted. A stronger color is a larger share.

1.name: report
1.tooltip: What happened, and any notes.

KiLoRATokenRoles.description: Sets which tokens the mods of a mod list change in an editing workflow: the target image, the reference images or the text. Other tokens keep the base weights.

sets.name: mod list
sets.tooltip: A mod list from another mod list node. Leave empty to start a new list.

roles.name: roles
roles.tooltip: auto: the mod's own policy, else the LoRA file's, else the target tokens when reference images are present. target: the image being made. reference: the reference images. all: every token, as without roles.

apply_to.name: apply to
apply_to.tooltip: whole list: every mod in the incoming list. last mod: only the mod added last.

custom.name: custom roles
custom.tooltip: Optional. A role list that replaces the choice above, for example reference:0+text for the first reference image and the text.

0.name: mod list
0.tooltip: Connect it to the next mod list node or to KiLoRA Apply Mod List.

KiLoRATwoPanels.description: Marks a two-panel canvas. One panel holds the reference picture and the other is the image being made. Mods on auto roles change only the target panel. Applies to every mod of the list.

sets.name: mod list
sets.tooltip: A mod list from another mod list node. Leave empty to start a new list.

reference_side.name: reference side
reference_side.tooltip: The side of the canvas that holds the reference picture.

split.name: split
split.tooltip: The part of the canvas width (left, right) or height (top, bottom) that the reference panel covers.

0.name: mod list
0.tooltip: Connect it to the next mod list node or to KiLoRA Apply Mod List.

KiLoRARegionIsolation.description: Experimental. Keeps the area outside the KiLoRA regions as the base model makes it. In the first part of sampling, a base-only branch runs next to the sampler, and the outside follows it. Each step in that part costs one extra model call. Connect it after KiLoRA Apply.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: The model to load into. The original model is not changed.

strength.name: strength
strength.tooltip: How far the outside follows the base model. 1: fully, 0: off.

until.name: until
until.tooltip: The part of the sampler steps that the isolation acts in, from the start. After it, the image settles freely, so the edge can heal.

feather.name: feather
feather.tooltip: The soft edge of the regions, in pixels. Larger values blend the edge over a wider band.

sets.name: mod list
sets.tooltip: Optional. The mod list whose regions to isolate (the same list as on KiLoRA Apply). Without it, the regions of the list that KiLoRA Apply loaded.

0.name: model
0.tooltip: The model with the mods.

1.name: report
1.tooltip: What happened, and any notes.

KiLoRATimeline.description: Sets one value over the run: the strength of a mod, or when it is active, for example. Chain Timeline nodes to add rows, and connect the last one to KiLoRA Apply or the LoRA loader. The preview plots every row.

target.name: target
target.tooltip: all, an axis (creative, functional or ip), or the file name of a mod or LoRA in the mod list, without the extension.

quantity.name: quantity
quantity.tooltip: What the row sets. strength multiplies the strength. active turns the mod on (1) or off (0). route_freeze and gate_kappa replace the inputs of KiLoRA Apply. The region quantities set the strength of that effect over time. depth_map and depth_base control the depth map (target all).

curve.name: curve
curve.tooltip: Keyframes such as 0:1, 0.3:0.6, 1:0.2 (position:value), or an expression with t, step, steps and sigma, for example 1 - t.

clock.name: clock
clock.tooltip: What the keyframe positions mean. progress: 0 at the first step, 1 at the last. step: the step number. sigma: the noise level.

interpolation.name: interpolation
interpolation.tooltip: linear: values blend between keyframes. step: each value holds until the next keyframe.

timeline.name: timeline
timeline.tooltip: Optional. Rows from another Timeline node; this node adds its rows after them.

more_rows.name: more rows
more_rows.tooltip: Optional. More rows, one per line: target | quantity | curve, then optional | clock and | interpolation.

0.name: timeline
0.tooltip: All rows. Connect it to KiLoRA Apply or to the next Timeline node.

1.name: preview
1.tooltip: Every row over the run: progress across, value up.

KiLoRADepthMap.description: A depth per image area, from a mask (SAM2 and other segmenters) or an image (its brightness: depth, lineart or pose maps from ControlNet preprocessors). Until start, every area runs one depth, so the layout forms as usual. Then each area runs its own depth. Connect it to KiLoRA Apply or KiLoRA LoRA Loader.

min_depth.name: min_depth
min_depth.tooltip: The depth where the map is 0 (black).

max_depth.name: max_depth
max_depth.tooltip: The depth where the map is 1 (white).

invert.name: invert
invert.tooltip: Swap black and white before the depths are set.

gamma.name: gamma
gamma.tooltip: Shapes the map before the depths are set: above 1 keeps more of it near min_depth, below 1 near max_depth.

feather.name: feather
feather.tooltip: The soft edge of the map, in pixels. A soft edge avoids a visible seam between depths.

start.name: start
start.tooltip: The sampling progress from which the map applies (0.3: after 30% of the steps). Before it every area runs base, so the layout stays as with one depth.

base.name: base
base.tooltip: The depth of every area before start, and of text tokens. -1: the mean depth of the map, rounded.

mask.name: mask
mask.tooltip: A mask, for example from SAM2. 1 gives max_depth. If an image is also connected, the mask is used.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: An image. Its brightness is the map, for example the output of a depth, lineart or pose preprocessor.

0.name: depth_map
0.tooltip: The depth map. Connect it to the depth_map input of KiLoRA Apply or KiLoRA LoRA Loader.

1.name: preview
1.tooltip: The map as an image: black is min_depth, white is max_depth.

KiLoRALayerConditioning.description: Selects the axes for this conditioning and sets its mask.

layer.name: layer
layer.tooltip: The axis for this layer. creative also runs functional.

alpha_source.name: alpha source
alpha_source.tooltip: mask uses the connected mask. attention uses the previous step’s trigger maps for IP and the complement for creative.

feather.name: feather
feather.tooltip: The soft edge of the regions, in pixels. Larger values blend the edge over a wider band.

crop.name: crop
crop.tooltip: off: the whole image. auto: faster, crops the late steps with surrounding context.

batch.name: batch
batch.tooltip: Run this layer in one batched model call with the other layers. Off: each layer runs as its own call, which is exact and at 1024 pixels faster. Turn it on for all layers to batch them.

compose.name: compose
compose.tooltip: separate: each layer runs as its own model call. single: all layers run in one model call per guidance branch, and each image area reads its own layer text. Select single on every layer. The crop input is not used with single.

0.name: conditioning
0.tooltip: Conditioning for this layer.

model.name: model

filename.name: file name

candidates.name: Candidates

direction_file.name: Direction file

model.name: model

folders.name: folders

KiLoRAMentionPrompt.description: Encode a prompt in which @name calls a LoRA from the library. The mentions are removed before the text encoder and added to the mod list.

text.name: text

sets.name: mod list
sets.tooltip: Optional. The mentioned LoRAs are added to this mod list.

layer.name: layer

2.tooltip: Which file each mention uses, and which trigger words were added to the prompt.

KiLoRAPromptSet.description: Build prompt pairs from subjects, style and cue, or JSON. Chain nodes to add concepts.

subjects.name: Subjects
subjects.tooltip: One subject per line. An LLM node can supply this text.

style.name: Style
style.tooltip: Full style description used by the target prompt.

cue.name: Cue
cue.tooltip: Short cue in the student prompt and the exported trigger words.

label.name: Concept label

json.name: Prompt set JSON
json.tooltip: Optional JSON concepts or explicit pairs. Overrides the text fields.

prompt_set.name: Prompt set
prompt_set.tooltip: Concepts and prompt pairs. Chain Prompt Set nodes to add concepts.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Base model used for sampling and fitting the LoRA.

clip.name: CLIP
clip.tooltip: Text encoder for target, student and negative prompts.

prompt_set.name: Prompt set
prompt_set.tooltip: Concepts and prompt pairs. Chain Prompt Set nodes to add concepts.

name.name: Name
name.tooltip: Output file stem. Batch sets with one shared name receive numbered stems.

mode.name: Mode

rank.name: Rank
rank.tooltip: Rank of each fitted projection. Default 16.

steps.name: Steps

size.name: Size
size.tooltip: Square image size in pixels, a multiple of 16. 0 uses the model family's default.

negative_prompt.name: Negative prompt

overwrite.name: Overwrite

output.name: Output

sets.name: Mod list

preview.name: Preview

model.name: Model

clip.name: CLIP
clip.tooltip: Text encoder for target, student and negative prompts.

vae.name: VAE

name.name: Name
name.tooltip: Output filename stem: letters, numbers, underscores or dashes.

cue.name: Cue
cue.tooltip: Cue used with each caption on both sides and stored as the LoRA trigger words.

rank.name: Rank
rank.tooltip: Rank of each fitted projection. Default 16.

steps.name: Steps
steps.tooltip: Target trajectory steps. 0 uses the model family's default.

cfg.name: CFG
cfg.tooltip: Guidance strength of the target trajectories. -1 uses the model family's default.

size.name: Size
size.tooltip: Square image size in pixels, a multiple of 16. 0 uses the model family's default.

ignore_guard.name: Ignore guard

overwrite.name: Overwrite

images.name: Images

captions.name: Captions

common.name: Common directions

family.name: Family directions

seed.name: Seed

0.name: Pack folder
